scope: Existing inputs, official selected-evidence labels, hashes, finite sentence caches, derived scores, archived sufficient statistics, timing/preflight/session receipts. No new model loading, inference, training, network/API request or modification of frozen scientific evidence.
limitations: Existing benchmark has already been evaluated by earlier methods; this is a separately frozen extension, not a newly untouched holdout.
No checkpoint, threshold, ensemble rule or recipe may be selected using these test outcomes.
Two set rules are reported as declared, regardless of whether either improves test F1.
DeepSeek=100 is a matched empirical F1 ratio, not a theoretical upper bound.
Whole-bag intervals condition on fixed checkpoints/predictions; they do not measure generation or training-seed variation.
Historical original-large results are preserved; a new matched parent uses exactly the LoRA input/prompt order and forward.
Local CPU latency, sampled process RSS, deployment bytes, training cost and API expenditure are separate dimensions.
Successful cached inference time excludes loading, preflight, warmup, failures and disk writes; complete worker sessions are retained locally.
